question: How do they measure style transfer success?
title: Grammatical Error Correction and Style Transfer via Zero-shot Monolingual Translation
answer_short: They measure style transfer success by calculating the root mean square error (RMSE) between human evaluator scores and desired style direction values.
answer_rationale: The method described in block 68 involves calculating the average score from three evaluators, assigning +1 for more formal, -1 for more informal, and 0 for no change, then computing RMSE against desired values. An RMSE of 0 indicates perfect style transfer, while 2 indicates complete failure. This quantitative measure is explicitly used to evaluate style transfer success.
